verdict.rationale: Docs show many UI actions—creating subscriptions, editing subscriptions, configuring billing metrics, exports, webhooks—are explicitly available via API endpoints (orb-docs-8, orb-docs-10, orb-docs-12, orb-doces-18, orb-docs-23), suggesting strong UI/API parity for core billing workflows.
